match_count = 0
patient_ids = [
    "P01", "P02", "P03", "P05", "P06", "P10", "P11", "P12", "P13", "P14",
    "P32", "P33", "P34", "P35", "P36", "P37", "P38", "P39", "P40", "P41",
    "P42", "P43"
]

# Map from read_figure rows (indexes 0-21 for patients)
vision_rows = [
    {"id": "P01", "match": "No"},
    {"id": "P02", "match": "Yes"},
    {"id": "P03", "match": "Yes"},
    {"id": "P05", "match": "Yes"},
    {"id": "P06", "match": "Yes"},

    {"id": "P41", "match": "Yes"},
    {"id": "P42", "match": "Yes"},
    {"id": "P43", "match": "Yes"},
]

for i, row in enumerate(vision_rows):
    patient_id = row["id"]
    # Score is 1 if match (correct prediction), 0 otherwise; truth is 1 for all (since we're counting correct matches for accuracy)
    # Alternatively: score = 1 if model prediction matches clinical truth, truth = 1
    score = {"ref": f"vision/3c10374ffe09/R{i+1}C5", "map": {"Yes": 1, "No": 0}}
    truth = {"ref": f"vision/3c10374ffe09/R{i+1}C4", "map": {"Good response": 0, "Poor response": 1}}  # Good response = sensitive (0), Poor = resistant (1)
    records.append({
        "id": patient_id,
        "score": score,
        "truth": truth
    })
    if row["match"] == "Yes":
        match_count +=1

accuracy = match_count / 22
print(f"Calculated accuracy: {accuracy}, matches: {match_count}, total: 22")
